why: Mostly code: most tasks are small programs to write and test.

pd-first-class-functions.why: passing, storing and returning functions is best learned by writing a small dispatcher

pd-closures.why: late binding is a behaviour to predict and explain, then fix two ways

pd-what-is-a-decorator.why: a definition; the tasks on syntax and wrappers exercise it

pd-decorator-syntax.why: rewriting @dec as f = dec(f) and back is checkable in code

pd-wrapper-functions.why: a wrapper that passes any arguments through and returns the result is a test-shaped skill

pd-decoration-time.why: which lines run at decoration and which per call shows up directly in tests

pd-decorator-factories.why: the three levels of a factory are learned by building one

pd-retry-decorator.why: a retry loop with a bare re-raise and argument checks is a classic implement-and-test task

pd-stacked-decorators.why: the order of evaluation, application and calls is a behaviour to predict and explain

pd-functools-partial.why: frozen and call-time arguments combine in ways tests pin down

pd-optional-argument-decorators.why: a decorator that works with and without parentheses has to be built and tested

pd-registration-decorators.why: a plugin registry keyed by name is a small program to write

pd-attribute-tagging.why: why a tag disappears under a wrapper without wraps is worth explaining

pd-lru-cache.why: memoization, hashable arguments and cache_info are checkable in code

pd-class-decorators.why: a class decorator that adds a method is a short program with clear tests

pd-descriptor-basics.why: a first __get__ and the class-versus-instance lookup are testable

pd-descriptor-protocol.why: the lookup order between data descriptors, the instance dict and non-data descriptors is explained, not memorised

pd-set-name.why: a descriptor that stores per-instance values under its own name is built and tested

pd-property.why: properties with and without setters are quick to write and test

pd-bound-methods.why: why a class-based decorator loses self on a method is a behaviour to predict and explain

pd-classmethod-staticmethod.why: what each __get__ returns and why classmethod goes on top are explained, then predicted

pd-validator-descriptors.why: a reusable validator descriptor is the unit's capstone program
